method: 40 slot starts are cumulative report durations minus 800 ms at every track transition, including repeat boundary.
Each automatic cue is assigned to slots by its start timestamp; crossfade boundary cues may have two assignments and are flagged.
Within each slot, SequenceMatcher aligns normalized Hangul/Latin/digits to the unchanged source lyrics, preserving monotonic order.
Exact character coverage is a text-correspondence diagnostic, not proof that the source words were sung or that cue timestamps equal vocal onset.
Internal-onset estimate means the first matched automatic cue also maps a previous source line, the first matched lyric character is beyond position 2, or no exact characters match.
ASR gaps at least 8 seconds include leading, between-cue, and trailing gaps; they are not proof of instrumental sections.
Two passes are independently aligned to the same unchanged lyrics; their offsets can corroborate but cannot establish exact vocal timing.
